title: Abandoned Doll Studio
description: A weathered, cracked wooden doll with button eyes and jointed limbs sits slumped against an easel in a dilapidated purple room. The floor is covered in scattered children's balls, a wooden crate labeled 'STUDIO FRAGILE', paint tubes, and debris, while a single hanging bulb illuminates child-like shadow figures and torn papers on the decaying walls.
prompt: A haunting surreal scene inside a derelict artist's studio with peeling purple walls and cracked blue wooden floor. A large weathered wooden artist's doll with button eyes sits broken against an easel, surrounded by scattered colorful balls, a wooden crate labeled STUDIO FRAGILE, paint tubes and debris. A single bare lightbulb hangs from the ceiling casting dramatic light on child-like shadow figures drawn on the walls and torn paper fragments, highly detailed, atmospheric, melancholic
